comment: task recipe-b6b-small-maps-cnc-assembler-nanofab — the RM.CNC gear walk (Loader_Recipes_Woods.java:259-263, the WoodDictionary.LIST_PLANKS body): per plank material whose gearGt item exists, 4x plank + 1 mB lubricant -> 1 wood gear, eut 16 / duration 64 verbatim. Family expansion is the PORT-universe subset: 128 of the 130 registered OP.plank materials carry a gearGt item (Bark planks have none — the upstream ST.valid(tGear) gate drops the same leg); rows sorted by material internal name (the walk order is not upstream-significant). The FluidsGT.LUBRICANT family = {gt6:lubricant} in the port (the 'rc lubricant' RotaryCraft alias is unregistered and never fired upstream either). The ST.tag(0) circuit selector legs are DROPPED — the JSON v1 row schema carries no damage/NBT faces and a configured Integrated Circuit is not expressible as a plain item id (the press.json:2/loom.json precedent; declared deviation: the rows answer without the circuit). KJS: datapack domain, zero adaptation.
